summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.90. Confirmed account takeover pattern: three failed sign-ins followed by one successful sign-in for m.aslan@aegean.edu, all from the same external IP 185.213.44.9 (SprayNet AS, Moscow, RU). The successful portal sign-in had mfa_prompt_count=0 and no device_id, meaning no MFA challenge was issued/completed and no device context exists. Signing in from Russia via an AS literally named "SprayNet" is inconsistent with a legitimate Aegean University user. This is a credential-spray success indicating compromised credentials; immediate containment (disable account, force password reset, revoke active sessions) is required.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
